description: This file contains unit tests for verifying correct forwarding of custom headers to the Bedrock rerank API within the litellm library. It tests both synchronous and asynchronous rerank functions, ensuring headers specified via parameters are properly included in the API requests, and also checks correct merging of headers from different sources.

classes.name: HTTPHandler
classes.description: A class for handling synchronous HTTP requests within the litellm library.

classes.name: AsyncHTTPHandler
classes.description: A class for handling asynchronous HTTP requests within the litellm library.

methods.name: test_bedrock_rerank_header_forwarding_sync(model)
methods.description: Tests that custom headers are correctly forwarded in synchronous rerank API calls.

methods.name: test_bedrock_rerank_header_forwarding_async(model)
methods.description: Tests that custom headers are correctly forwarded in asynchronous rerank API calls.

methods.name: test_bedrock_rerank_extra_headers_and_headers_merge()
methods.description: Verifies proper merging of headers from proxy forwarding and explicit parameters for rerank API calls.

ctags.name: test_query
ctags.pattern: /^test_query = "What is the capital of the United States?"$/

fields.name: test_query = "What is the capital of the United States?"
